summary: Make Settings easier to scan, stabilize voice-driven suggestions, keep reset reversible and use installed Parakeet Ultra by default.

changes.title: Reuse unchanged panel glass recordings
changes.detail: The Emoji, Clipboard, and Toolbar frosted overlays now retain their GPU RenderNode recording between unchanged frames and refresh it on scrolling, layout, sizing, and explicit surface updates. This removes repeated source-tree recording while preserving the same live in-panel content and blur.

changes.title: Remove the stale Search row above Emoji Browse
changes.detail: Emoji Search results and the no-results panel now remain hidden whenever Search mode is off, including when an asynchronous Search refresh arrives after leaving Search. This prevents the fixed 56dp row from stealing height above the category tabs and emoji grid. The content-free geometry report now includes visibility states for these Search-only rows.

changes.title: Compare Parakeet models on the same Voice Lab recording
changes.detail: The Offline voice settings select between verified installed Parakeet packs. Ultra 0.6B is preferred by default when installed; 110M remains available as the lower-memory fallback. The selected model is used for keyboard offline dictation, while the A/B lab continues to compare both on the same take. brrClean has one on/off control and defaults to on. No model weights are bundled in this update; already installed models remain in private app storage. The release workflow keeps an explicit bundle_ultra_model option for a future update only when requested.

changes.title: Keep only important confirmations in Do Not Disturb
changes.detail: Key taps and gesture haptics remain quiet during DND. The optional important-only setting allows brief confirmations when changing privacy mode or confirming a clipboard/history clear. If Android cannot provide the current DND state, the keyboard safely suppresses ordinary haptics until it can. The preference is located only in Everyday tools → Sound & haptics.

changes.title: Keep the guided checkup as the single diagnostic report flow
changes.detail: The seven-step Settings checkup covers Emoji spacing, suggestions, toolbar, panel blur, active voice controls, same-audio A/B, and important DND haptics. One final text report contains the fresh geometry trace and numeric-only model metrics; typed text, transcripts, audio and clipboard contents stay out of it. Redundant standalone geometry and Voice Lab copy actions were removed.

changes.title: Focus BR Brain on suggestions and local learning
changes.detail: Voice model selection, cleaning, install availability, and A/B comparison now live under Everyday tools → Offline voice. BR Brain no longer duplicates voice controls or exposes extra diagnostic-copy actions.

changes.title: Make Settings calmer without removing controls
changes.detail: Everyday actions now sit in a shorter, grouped Settings home. Less-used controls remain available under an expandable Advanced controls section, with clearer descriptions and lighter icon treatment.

changes.title: Add a reversible settings reset
changes.detail: A deliberate slide action at the end of Settings resets preferences while preserving dictionaries, clipboard history, recordings and installed voice models. A separate Undo changes action remains available for one hour. The slider gives continuous restrained haptics while held when haptics are enabled, including the important-actions-only Do Not Disturb mode, without needing the keyboard service to be running.

changes.title: Bound offline update history
changes.detail: Settings displays at most the ten newest valid signed updates, and the release history generator also writes only those ten entries so bundled history data cannot grow without bound.

changes.title: Keep suggestions steady during ChatGPT voice input
changes.detail: When ChatGPT streams speech into its text field without keyboard typing, brrBoard briefly holds changing prediction rows and shows the latest results after the transcript settles. A privacy-safe checkup step records only selection-update and held-suggestion counts; it never records words, transcripts, audio or screenshots.
